text:
Iris Nguyen: Kickoff for Sept 21 webinar "Build & Ship: Inference Cost Control Lab". Goal: practical lab + one customer micro-postmortem. Thoughts on format?
Marco Silva: Keep it compact. 10m framing, 20m hands-on lab (attendees run a small repo), 15m postmortem + 15m live Q&A. Total 60m.
Priya Singh: We should A/B two landing intros: Tech-first (bench numbers) vs Outcome-first (customer dollars saved). We'll route by role.
Jonah Lee: Bench plan: run median of 5 for short/long prompts across baseline vs tuned pipeline. I'll produce a small table with p50/p95 and $/1M tokens. Need the prompt set by EOD.
Samira Khan: I can own the lab repos: cheap-config + conservative-latency-config + bench harness. Will include quickstart scripts and a seeded dataset.
Iris Nguyen: Draft run-of-show: 
```
0:00 Host intro & goals (Iris) - 5m
0:05 Micro-postmortem (Customer) - 10m
0:15 Bench brief (Jonah) - 5m
0:20 Guided lab (Samira) - 20m
0:40 Live debug Q&A (Panel) - 15m
0:55 CTAs + wrap (Iris) - 5m
```
Marco Silva: Rehearsal cadence: full run Sept 18, tech-check Sept 20 (audio + fallback clip test). @calendar-bot please create invites and attach a fallback clips folder.
calendar-bot: Events created: "Sept 18 Full Rehearsal" and "Sept 20 Tech Check". Recording enabled; fallback folder attached.
Priya Singh: Registration form fields: company, role, monthly tokens, primary pain (cost/latency/ops/quality), preferred demo (cheap vs fidelity). Routing: <100k -> SDR A, 100k-5M -> SDR B, >5M -> AE. Samira, can you add a hidden demo-choice param to the form so we pre-seed the lab?
Samira Khan: Yep. Will wire the form and include a hidden field that maps to the sandbox preset. Preview link by EOD tomorrow.
Jonah Lee: Bench numbers: I'll post median CSV + a one-slide summary that we can use in the landing hero. Recommendation: use absolute numbers alongside percent deltas for credibility.
Iris Nguyen: Marketing asks: two short abstracts and three subject lines per audience variant by Sept 8. Also need speaker bios + headshots by Sept 7.
Marco Silva: Backup policy for live demos: every demo has a recorded fallback; if p95 > threshold or error rate rises for 2m -> producer swaps in clip + host walks through results. Samira please prepare pre-seeded responses and a 2-step swap runbook.
Samira Khan: Will prepare pre-seeded JSONL for lab scenarios + a 2-step runbook in the repo. Also adding a small smoke test script to validate sandbox health at rehearsal start.
Priya Singh: Measurement plan: track subject variant CTR, landing conversion, attendee role split, demo repo pick rate, and CTA clicks (cost estimate / trial / AE request). We'll use these to tune post-webinar nurture.
Iris Nguyen: Great. Next steps owners: Priya = copy & landing A/B, Jonah = bench CSV, Samira = repos + form wiring, Marco = run show + rehearsal ops. Locking plan unless objections. :rocket:
